name: @w6w-apps/pushover
description: Send push notifications to phones, tablets and desktops through Pushover — including emergency-priority messages that retry until acknowledged.

w6w.longDescription:
Pushover sends push notifications to phones, tablets and desktops through Pushover's small four-endpoint API, including emergency-priority messages that repeat until someone acknowledges them or a set time expires. A single connection pairs an application token with a recipient's user or group key, so sending a notification is a one-step call rather than a per-message credential lookup — though a different recipient can still be named per call when needed.

Message text, title and link fields are checked against Pushover's own length limits before sending, so a workflow finds out at the boundary rather than having its text silently truncated. Emergency-priority messages are validated locally too — the required retry interval and expiry are enforced together, so a misconfigured emergency alert fails with a clear reason instead of being silently ignored by Pushover.

Quota is read live from Pushover's own limits endpoint rather than declared unknown, since Pushover publishes the real numbers: a monthly allowance shared by every application on the account, with sending disabled entirely once it's exhausted rather than merely throttled.
